2026_01_CLE_JAX.headline: Cleveland’s rebuilt protection gets tested immediately by Jacksonville
2026_01_CLE_JAX.paragraph1: Cleveland opens with Deshaun Watson behind a reworked offensive line, including rookie Austin Barber stepping into a starting role, while Jacksonville enters with its own protection questions up front. That puts both quarterbacks under pressure to manage negative plays rather than chase explosives too early. Trevor Lawrence has the cleaner continuity in Jacksonville’s system, but Cleveland’s defense can shorten possessions if it wins inside. Protection communication, third-down pressure and which offense avoids drive-killing sacks should decide the opener.
2026_01_CLE_JAX.model_rationale: Jacksonville owns the steadier offensive environment, while Cleveland’s upset path depends on surviving its line transition and creating enough defensive pressure to disrupt Lawrence’s timing.
